description.zh: 翻页令牌，用于获取下一页数据。如果响应结果中没有提供，则传空字符串（""）或空字符（''）。
description.en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of results. If a NextPageToken is not returned in the response, pass an empty string ("").
The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 1,000.

description.zh: 角色名称匹配的正则表达式。支持模糊搜索，比如.\*test.\*。
description.en: A regular expression that the role name must match. Fuzzy search is supported. For example, .\*test.\*.
